significance.justification: Verified true, the claim would establish a form-(iii) predictive coupling: a "heavy-tailed distribution" of token-level task information and causal influence in which the three mechanistic signals "jointly predict which tokens can be pruned with negligible accuracy loss," supplemented by a form-(ii) claim that dropping low-scoring tokens preserves answers. This supplies both a behavioral phenomenon—reasoning traces contain substantial inert spans—and a causal mechanism—the load-bearing positions carry residual-stream information and consequential KV state; it would constrain expectations about where computation occurs, especially given Pfau et al.'s 2024 finding in “Let's Think Dot by Dot” that apparently meaningless filler positions can instead support hidden computation. The true and false states are distinguishable despite unquantified terms such as "substantial" and "negligible": a uniform or weakly predictive distribution would rule out the proposed sparse computational-skeleton account, although it would not rule out other forms of trace compression. In the topic-substitution check, efficient mechanistic reasoning alone would not earn this score; the measurable heavy-tail and cross-signal predictive relation are specific additions beyond the median redundancy-and-pruning hypothesis.

reach.justification: The named handles are a "mechanistic per-token diagnostic" and an online local-activation predictor "enabling a streaming compressor that halts or skips inert spans"; the latter is ex ante because it identifies a token or span without lookahead while there is still an opportunity to avoid subsequent computation. After per-model re-extraction, the claimed relation predicts that low attribution, low task information, and low causal influence will coincide and forecast safe pruning, so more than a mere search procedure survives recalibration, although no quantitative threshold or scaling law is asserted. The stated scope covers reasoning-tuned models and math and logic tasks, with acknowledged uncertainty across model families and training regimes; likely downstream users include inference-system researchers and practitioners who gate or ship compressed reasoning, rather than only analysts explaining completed traces. The topic-substitution check does not preserve this score: the ex-ante streaming diagnostic and transferable cross-signal relation, not the general goal of efficient reasoning, provide the above-median reach.
